root_cause: command-status-tool.ts:240-246 inherited a `snap.state !== "containment_failed"` guard that was originally added to mirror Path A wake-consumer semantics. The guard was correctly load-bearing for Path B (notify=true resolveObligation: the wake has no listener for containment_failed), but it ALSO gated out Path C (non-notify consumeNonNotifyTerminalObservation). The vscode-run-commands-tool.ts:892-913 non-notify record path registers observations UNCONDITIONALLY for every terminal state, including containment_failed, so a notify=false containment_failed job leaves the observation registered indefinitely. The BCB barrier holds on unconsumedOwnedTerminalResultsForC10 > 0 and the second submit_and_exit never reaches task_completion_committed.
repair: Add a new Path C' branch at command-status-tool.ts:307-350 that drains the non-notify terminal observation EVEN when snap.state === "containment_failed". Path B (the notify=true resolveObligation call) keeps the containment_failed exclusion intact. The Path C' branch is bounded: it consults the SAME BackgroundNotifyCoordinator.consumeNonNotifyTerminalObservation function, the SAME owner-mismatch check (hasActiveNotify guard + ownerKey validation), and reuses the SAME owner identity (resolveActiveOwner). No new wiring, no new state, no new protocol field.
